q: Where is personal data most often forgotten in AI systems?
options: Logs, traces, vector indexes, memory and eval sets
explain: Every copy needs redaction, retention and deletion.

q: Why is fine-tuning on raw transcripts risky?
options: Models can memorize rare strings and reproduce them
explain: Training-data extraction attacks have recovered memorized text.

q: What must a deletion request reach?
options: Every copy: indexes, caches, memory, logs and eval sets
explain: Copies outlive deletions unless you track them.
